card.name: Metaphor and idiom nouns in essays
card.fires_on: The key noun in a figure of speech or idiom in general web prose, such as swamp, bull, pie, ship, switch or foxes. It marks the image word of a metaphor or simile.

modes.label: Idiom object noun
modes.description: The noun that completes a set phrase like grab the bull or turn the ship around.
modes.example: "The best way to do this is to grab the<< bull>> by the horns and deal with the issue

modes.label: Simile or metaphor image
modes.description: The comparison image in an analogy, such as a switch, a tennis match, or foxes and hedgehogs.
modes.example: The first type are fox<<es>>, the second type are hedgehogs

card.plain: It lights up on the picture word in a metaphor or saying, like the bull in grab the bull by the horns.
